q: ¿Cuándo es válida una técnica aunque los atletas salgan del área de competición?
consulta_en: When is a technique valid even if the athletes go out of the competition area
modo: Síntesis Analítica IA (Gemini / gemini-flash-lite-latest; citas SOR validadas; respaldo literal verificado, sin entailment)

respuesta_final.summary: Una técnica de proyección iniciada dentro del área de competición puede ser válida aunque ambos atletas salgan de ella si cumple con las condiciones de continuidad y distancia en la zona de seguridad, o si se trata de ne-waza [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151).
respuesta_final.normative_basis: Sport and Organisation Rules of the International Judo Federation, Article 5 Location (Valid Areas) [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151), página 151.
respuesta_final.conditions_and_exceptions: a) Cuando una proyección se inicia con un solo atleta en contacto con el área de competición y ambos salen, la acción puede considerarse si continúa ininterrumpida en la proximidad del límite y no más de dos metros en la zona de seguridad [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151). Igualmente, cualquier contratécnica inmediata del atleta que no estaba en contacto puede considerarse si continúa bajo las mismas condiciones [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151). b) La acción de ne-waza dirigida a osaekomi-waza, kansetsu-waza o shime-waza es válida y puede continuar fuera si comenzó desde dentro [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151). Kansetsu-waza y shime-waza iniciadas dentro y efectivas pueden mantenerse fuera mientras haya progresión [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151). c) Ne-waza fuera: si la proyección termina fuera en la proximidad del límite y no más de dos metros en la zona de seguridad y se aplica inmediatamente osaekomi-waza, shime-waza o kansetsu-waza, será válida mientras haya progresión [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151). Si uke toma el control con estas técnicas en sucesión continua, también será válido [SOR-2026-08-P151-S178](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=151).

q: What happens if an athlete is injured and cannot continue the contest?
consulta_en: What happens if an athlete is injured and cannot continue the contest?
modo: Síntesis Analítica IA (Gemini / gemini-flash-lite-latest; citas SOR validadas; respaldo literal verificado, sin entailment)

respuesta_final.summary: If an athlete is injured and cannot continue the contest, the outcome is determined by the referee following specific clauses under Article 20.1 [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). Where the cause of the injury is attributed to the injured athlete, he shall lose the contest [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). Where it is impossible to determine which of the athletes was the cause of the injury, the athlete unable to continue shall lose the contest [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). Where the injury is caused by athletes from another contest on a nearby tatami, or by an external object including LED boards, advertising boards, or cameras, the injured athlete has the right to ask the referee to see the doctor, treatment can be given if needed, and the athlete can continue the contest if able [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). Where the athlete is injured due to an action by the opponent and cannot continue, the referee, the IJF Head Referee Director(s) and/or the IJF Referee Supervisor(s) shall review the incident and decide the outcome based on the rules [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). If the athlete asks the referee to call for the doctor, the contest is terminated and his opponent wins by kiken-gachi [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). If the doctor asks to attend to his athlete, the contest is terminated and the opponent wins by kiken-gachi [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). If the doctor advises the referees that the athlete cannot continue after an examination, the referee, after consultation with the IJF Head Referee Director(s), IJF Referee Supervisor(s) and the IJF Medical Commissioner, shall end the contest and declare the opponent to be the winner by kiken-gachi [SOR-2026-08-P197-S207](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=197). If an injured athlete needs prolonged medical treatment on the tatami, the referee will declare the non-injured opponent as the winner [SOR-2026-08-P197-S207](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=197).
respuesta_final.normative_basis: Sport and Organisation Rules of the International Judo Federation, Article 20.1 Continuation of a Contest (page 196) [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196) and Article 20.2 Medical Examinations and Treatment Inside the Contest Area (page 197) [SOR-2026-08-P197-S207](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=197).
respuesta_final.conditions_and_exceptions: Where the injury is caused by athletes from another contest on a nearby tatami or by an external object including but not limited to LED boards, advertising boards, or cameras, the injured athlete has the right to ask the referee to see the doctor, treatment can be given if needed, and the athlete can continue the contest if able [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). If the athlete asks the referee to call for the doctor, the contest is terminated, and his opponent shall win by kiken-gachi [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). If the doctor asks to attend to his athlete, the contest is terminated, and the opponent will win by kiken-gachi [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196).

If the doctor asks to attend to his athlete, the contest is terminated and the opponent wins by kiken-gachi [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196). If the doctor advises the referees that the athlete cannot continue after an examination, the referee, after consultation with the IJF Head Referee Director(s), IJF Referee Supervisor(s) and the IJF Medical Commissioner, shall end the contest and declare the opponent to be the winner by kiken-gachi [SOR-2026-08-P197-S207](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=197). If an injured athlete needs prolonged medical treatment on the tatami, the referee will declare the non-injured opponent as the winner [SOR-2026-08-P197-S207](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=197).

When the injured athlete or their doctor initiates a request for the doctor to enter for treatment, the contest is automatically terminated resulting in a kiken-gachi win for the opponent, with the exception of external causes such as nearby tatami incidents or external objects where treatment is allowed and continuation is permitted if the athlete is able [SOR-2026-08-P196-S206](https://78884ca60822a34fb0e6-082b8fd5551e97bc65e327988b444396.ssl.cf3.rackcdn.com/up/2026/08/IJF_Sport_and_Organisation_Rul-1787430903.pdf#page=196).
